description: A lab has 1000 units of medicinal ingredients to make two pills, a large pill and a small pill. A large pill requires 3 units of medicinal ingredients and 2 units of filler. A small pill requires 2 units of medicinal ingredients and 1 unit of filler. The lab has to make at least 100 large pills. However, since small pills are more popular at least 60% of the total number of pills must be small. How many of each should be made to minimize the total number of filler material needed?

TotalMedicinalIngredients.definition: Total units of medicinal ingredients available to produce pills

RequiredMedicinal.definition: Units of medicinal ingredients required to produce one unit of pill type i

RequiredFiller.definition: Units of filler required to produce one unit of pill type i

MinimumPills.definition: Minimum number of pills that must be produced for pill type i

MinimumProportion.definition: Minimum proportion of total pills that must be of pill type i

objective.description: "Minimize the total amount of filler material used to produce the large and small pills"
objective.code: model.setObjective(quicksum(RequiredFiller[i] * NumPills[i] for i in range(NumPillTypes)), GRB.MINIMIZE)

constraints.description: 3 × (number of large pills) + 2 × (number of small pills) ≤ TotalMedicinalIngredients
constraints.code:
model.addConstr(
    sum(RequiredMedicinal[i] * NumPills[i] for i in range(NumPillTypes)) 
    <= TotalMedicinalIngredients
)

constraints.description: Number of small pills ≥ 0.6 × (number of large pills + number of small pills)

NumPills.definition: Number of pills produced for each pill type (1 = large pill, 2 = small pill)
